caption: The drawing features a single black top hat positioned centrally near the bottom half of the page. The hat has a tall, cylindrical crown and a wide brim, both depicted in shades of black and gray with highlights indicating a glossy texture. The lower edge of the crown has a black ribbon around it. In the upper right quadrant of the image, there is a simple line sketch of the same top hat, but this version is uncolored and consists only of outline lines, which are gray and thin. The background consists of a plain, off-white or beige surface with no other objects or details. There is a small, faint inscription in gray in the bottom left corner.
title: Man's Hat
